finalists.label: Paraganglioma
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive evidence, including a contrast-enhancing mass in the bladder wall with surrounding lymphadenopathy.

finalists.label: Hypertension
finalists.why: It is directly supported by the patient's 2-year history of episodic hypertension and current high blood pressure.

finalists.label: Neuroendocrine tumor
finalists.why: It accounts for the isolated elevation in plasma normetanephrine and the high levels of urinary metanephrines and free norepinephrine.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of a contrast-enhancing mass in the bladder wall with surrounding lymphadenopathy specifically supports Paraganglioma over the broader category of Neuroendocrine tumor.
